gegeneinander.es: mutuamente, el uno contra el otro

bloques.titulo: Structure of infinitive prayer with supplements
texto: When an infinitive dependent on verbs such as **beabsichtigen, versuchen, planen, hoffen, versprechen** or locutions such as **bereit sein, die Absicht haben** carries own supplements (objects, adverbs), these are located in the center:
- **Die Firma beabsichtigt, [eine langfristige Partnerschaft mit dem Partner] einzugehen**.
- Specialized connectors: **um ... zu** (purpose), **ohne ... zu** (private mode), **anstatt ... zu** (replacement).

Coma rule: In modern German, the coma is always highly recommended and results in **estrictamente obligatoria** when the construction is introduced by **um, ohne, anstatt**, when it depends on a correlative pronoun (**es**) or when it avoids syntactic misunderstandings.

filas: Sie unterschrieb, ohne den Text zu lesen.
Sie planen, neue Standorte zu eröffnen.

frases.de: Die beiden Unternehmen beabsichtigen, eine langfristige Partnerschaft einzugehen.
frases.es: Ambas empresas tienen la intención de entablar una asociación a largo plazo.
frases.en: Both companies intend to establish a long-term partnership.

frases.de: Die Verhandlungsführer trafen sich gestern, um alle offenen Streitpunkte beizulegen.
frases.es: Los jefes de negociación se reunieron ayer para resolver todos los puntos de disputa pendientes.
frases.en: The negotiating leaders met yesterday to resolve all outstanding points of dispute.
analisis: for all outstanding points of dispute

frases.de: Die Vereinbarung wurde geschlossen, ohne die bisherigen Standorte zu gefährden.
frases.es: El acuerdo se cerró sin poner en riesgo las sedes actuales.
frases.en: The agreement was closed without jeopardizing the current headquarters.

frases.de: Anstatt gegeneinander zu konkurrieren, wollen die Konzerne gemeinsame Synergien nutzen.
frases.es: En vez de competir mutuamente, los consorcios quieren aprovechar sinergias comunes.
frases.en: Instead of competing with each other, consortia want to take advantage of common synergies.
analisis: instead of competing with each other

bloques.pregunta: Where is the «zu» particle placed in a separable verb within an infinitive construction?

opciones.texto: Intercalada entre el prefijo separable y la raíz del verbo: «beizulegen», «einzugehen».
opciones.explicacion: In verbs with separable prefix the particle «zu» is integrated into the inside of the word.

opciones.texto: In front of the whole main sentence before the subject.
opciones.explicacion: The «zu» particle is exclusively accompanied by the form of infinitive at the end.

opciones.texto: Always separated at the end of the prayer after the point.
opciones.explicacion: It forms a single graphic word with a separable verb.

bloques.frase: Die Parteien verhandeln seit Wochen, um den Konflikt friedlich ___ .

opciones.explicacion: In the «um ... zu»-dependent infinitive, the particle intersperses: «bei-zu-legen».
It is incorrect to put «zu» before the separable prefix.
It is an agrimatic placement in standard German.

bloques.frase: Die Vereinbarung wurde geschlossen, ohne die Standorte zu gefährden.

opciones.texto: Que el pacto alcanzado no pondrá en peligro la estabilidad de las sedes existentes.
opciones.explicacion: «ohne ... zu gefährden» points to the safeguarding of the facilities.

opciones.texto: That all the factories will move immediately to another continent.
opciones.explicacion: The text expressly guarantees that its continuity will not be compromised.

opciones.texto: That trade unions have called for an indefinite strike in the workplace.
opciones.explicacion: There is no strike, but a pact signature that protects the headquarters.

bloques.pregunta: When is the coma strictly mandatory in an infinitive construction?

opciones.texto: Cuando está introducida por conjunciones subordinantes de infinitivo como «um», «ohne» o «anstatt».
opciones.explicacion: In these constructions, the clause-separating coma is mandatory.

opciones.texto: Only when the sentence contains a number more than twenty words.
opciones.explicacion: The orthographic rule depends on the syntactic nature of the connector, not the lexicon compute.

opciones.texto: You never place a coma in the infinitive constructions in the German language.
opciones.explicacion: Coma is compulsory in the cases indicated by the official orthographic standard.

bloques.frase: Die Geschäftsführung beschloss, neue Märkte im Ausland ___ erschließen.

opciones.explicacion: With inseparable verbs like «erschließen» (prefix er-), «zu» is written separately: «zu erschließen».
The contraction with article is not used for the simple verbal infinitive.
It would introduce a purpose sentence if it were «um ... zu», not a direct complement.

bloques.pregunta: What strategy have you agreed on?
bloques.frase: Anstatt gegeneinander zu konkurrieren, wollen die Partner gemeinsame Synergien nutzen.

opciones.texto: Cooperate in mutual agreement to benefit together rather than to rival in the market.
opciones.explicacion: «Anstatt ... zu konkurrieren» discards destructive rivalry between partners.

opciones.texto: Start an aggressive price war to ruin the rival company.
opciones.explicacion: They have decided to cooperate and not to compete with each other.

opciones.texto: Dissolve both companies to settle their commercial assets.
opciones.explicacion: They create a strategic partnership to build on shared synergies.

bloques.frase: die Firmen beabsichtigen eine Partnerschaft einzugehen
bloques.traduccion: companies plan to enter into a partnership
bloques.explicacion: group of extended infinitive with separable verb.

intro: We studied **grupos de infinitivo ampliados** with **zu**: its orational architecture with intermediate supplements and the rules of score with coma.
